description: Defines the AudioDecoder interface for decoding encoded audio streams into playable audio data within the starboard::shared::starboard::player::filter namespace. Includes method declarations for initialization, decoding, reading decoded audio, resetting, and writing end of stream.

classes.name: AudioDecoder
classes.description: An interface class for decoding encoded audio streams into playable audio data, providing methods for initialization, decoding, reading output, resetting, and signaling end of stream.

methods.name: ~AudioDecoder
methods.description: Virtual destructor for the AudioDecoder interface.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with callbacks for output and error handling.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Feeds encoded audio data into the decoder for processing.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals that there is no more input data unless Reset() is called.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Retrieves the next decoded audio buffer, returning an EOS buffer if end of stream is reached.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Clears cached buffers and resets the decoder state, typically called during seek operations.
